messages:
Tom: Noticed a replay of the short-flow storm on eu-central dedicated-last-night — GPU p99 spiking and NIC tx queues overflowing. graphs: https://grafana/redwood/d/eu-central/shortflow-storm
Elena: Looks like connection-flood pattern: thousands of tiny RPCs from a handful of tenants causing tx-queue flushbacks. Not heavy compute.
Marcus: Can we try the "connection-flood-deflector" idea (proxy-level deflection + soft-drop) instead of blunt pool caps? It hedges while preserving throughput.
Priya: Agree. Deflector approach = per-tenant shortflow detection + short-window defer/backoff (retryable 429s) + emit node label so scheduler avoids packing more high-conn tenants.
Tom: PoC config (proxy):
```
deflector:
  enabled: true
  shortflow_window_ms: 200
  detect_rps_threshold: 1200
  action: soft_drop_with_retry_header
  tenant_overrides:
    tenant-Z7: {threshold: 800}
```
Elena: Important: soft_drop must include Retry-After and a structured header so SDKs can backoff gracefully. Also log a metric tenant_deflections_count.
Marcus: Rollout plan: 1) Canary on one eu-central hot-rack for 30m at 23:00 UTC. 2) Watch: node_nic_queue_len, tx_drops, gpu_p99, tenant_deflections_count, client_5xx. 3) If GPU p99 improves and client 5xx==0, expand.
Priya: Need product/billing sign-off for Dedicated customers. We'll make deflector an opt-in mitigation beta and offer a small credit if we kick in without opt-in.
infra-bot: Runbook stub: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/connection-flood-deflector. Canary ticket created: #CFD-8812.
Tom: Who's owning the rollout script? Marcus can own canary execution; Elena will push proxy flag; Priya will draft customer comms; I'll add dashboard panels for tenant_deflections_count and deflection_latency.
Marcus: Canary started at 5802520005 — initial metrics show deflections for tenant-Z7 and node_nic_queue_len dropping 45%. GPU p99 from 190ms -> 35ms.
infra-bot: Canary completed at 5802520025 — status: success :white_check_mark:
Elena: Good results. Next: open infra epic, add eBPF/SmartNIC spike to avoid proxy CPU cost, and formalize opt-in beta for Dedicated customers.
Tom: Closing loop here. Will post summary in #eng-releases and schedule follow-up with billing/legal.
